sanskrit:
अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वान्येभ्य उपासते ।
तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः ॥ १३-२६॥
iast:
anye tvevamajānantaḥ śrutvānyebhya upāsate
te’pi cātitarantyeva mṛtyuṃ śrutiparāyaṇāḥ 13-26
translation: Others also, not knowing this, worship, having heard of it from others; they too, cross beyond death, if they would regard what they have heard as their Supreme Refuge.
